rest-api-design document's content-section links (api-versioning, error-handling, http-methods) and related documents (api-versioning, error-handling, http-methods, rate-limiting) do not include itself.
Clicking 'API Versioning Strategy' link in expanded section navigated doc.title to 'API Versioning Strategy'.
Collapsing 'REST Principles' section hid content and disabled its reference links, showing 'Expand section to access link'.
Re-expanding the section restored body content and enabled links api-versioning/error-handling.
Toggle state field reflects open/closed and matches visibility of content/links in both states.
Clicking link in collapsed section showed toast 'Please expand the section to access links' and kept doc unchanged; after expanding, same link navigated to 'HTTP Methods Guide'.
Searching 'zzznonexistentxyz' showed 'No documents found' message; clearing search restored full 19-doc list.
Graph has 19 nodes matching the 19 documents; nodes are color-coded per module (distinct hsl fills for API/Auth/Data/etc groups); 19 connecting lines drawn for related-document relationships.
Graph node collection lists all 19 documents across modules with connecting lines; Reset View control available to bring the whole graph into view.

issue: Graph node click does not open document view
actual: Clicking (single or double click, verified via real Playwright click and dispatched events) a graph node (e.g. 'API Versioning Strategy') only toggles its 'selected' visual state; the app remains on the Knowledge Graph tab and no navigation to the document view occurs, despite the node being tagged navigation/target=document.detail.

evidence: Successfully switched among Documents, Knowledge Graph, and Favorites tabs; nav state 'active' updates correctly each time.

With HTTP Methods Guide open (method-semantics closed, idempotency open) and graph zoom set to 140%, switching Documents->Graph->Favorites->Graph preserved both the selected doc/section states and the 140% zoom.

issue: Favorites view is filtered by the Documents module filter instead of showing all favorites
actual: Favorites persisted after reload (count stayed '2') and count updated in real time when toggling; favorite markers survived module filtering and sorting in the Documents list. However, with the Documents module filter set to 'API', the Favorites tab list showed only 1 of 2 favorited documents (hid 'Design Tokens' which is a UI Components doc); after resetting the Documents filter to 'All', both favorited documents reappeared in Favorites. This violates the requirement that Favorites exposes every favorited document regardless of the module filter used in Documents.
